text: Chat agents run `claude` with cwd=agents/<id>/, so Claude Code loads that CLAUDE.md natively and resolves @-imports each session; AGENT-PROMPT.md sits in the same dir. BP path (agent-image/scripts/agent-entrypoint.py) instead reads CLAUDE.md raw and passes it via --system-prompt (no @import expansion).

buildAgentClaudeMd() (orchestrator/orchestrator.js:632) currently inlines the prompt at line 741; saveAgentPrompt() writes CLAUDE.md only at creation time. PUT /api/agents/:id/prompt (api.js:2099) writes only AGENT-PROMPT.md — root cause of #510.
PR #518 (copy-into-CLAUDE.md fix for #510) was closed unmerged in favour of the reference approach.

github-event triggers carry no createdAt (UI create api.js:2231, UI update :2251, derived channel triggers in process-template.js expandGithubChannels), so the poller's history horizon falls back to triggers.json mtime (github-poller.js:343). saveTriggers (orchestrator.js:1213) rewrites the file unconditionally on routine events (one-shot consumed :4789, team re-derive :4465/:4826, admin write-through) → mtime bump moves horizon to "now" → recently-arrived events dropped as history-horizon even for long-running, unchanged agents. Root cause of missed GitHub triggers.

#320 (CLOSED/COMPLETED) already diagnosed the mtime-horizon/missing-createdAt defect as its item 2, but the createdAt-stamping fix is NOT in current code — either partial fix or regression. #446 (CLOSED) = same root-cause class for code-reviewer channel trigger. New focused bug filed as #525.
